Though Fyodor Pavlovitch was a drunkard and a vicious debauchee he never neglected investing his capital, and managed his business affairs very successfully, though, no doubt, not over‐ scrupulously. She grew up in the house of a general’s widow, a wealthy old lady of good position, who was at once her benefactress and tormentor.
